name: Kizhi Church of the Transfiguration
description: The Cathedral of the Transfiguration is a church with an entirely wooden structure. It is located on Kizhi Island in the Republic of Karelia, Russia, in the center of Lake Onega, 68 kilometers away from the capital Petrozavodsk. The Cathedral of the Transfiguration is included in the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage - it is 37 meters high and has a total of 22 domes stacked on top of each other. This imaginative gesture makes visitors marvel at its majesty.
